title: Risk Terminal country risk readings — rt-data-2026-09
description:
Release rt-data-2026-09 of the Risk Terminal open data: daily country, regional and sub-national risk readings for 195 scored countries (201 tracked) and 9 regions, from 2026-04-18. Every row carries the model version and the SHA-256 parameter fingerprint of the engine that produced it, so readings from the same apparatus can be identified without publishing the apparatus.

Readings describe current conditions at each row's timestamp. This is not a prediction product.

The study design is pre-registered: DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/2SVZF. Each release folder includes a manifest with SHA-256 hashes, a data dictionary, a changelog and a standard-library verification script.
